review_scope: same-agent substantive critique of the exact current report and raw evidence

findings.finding: Controlled interruption left no trained endpoint; it cannot count as a scientific replicate.
findings.resolution: Retained pilot-a001 start/log/receipt and recovered under new attempt IDs; confirmation uses only seeds 1001--1004.

findings.finding: Pilot MPS allocation failed after CPU benchmarking.
findings.resolution: Kept failed attempt and separately qualified CPU with the full runner before freezing confirmation. No MPS measurements are analyzed.

findings.finding: Fixed absolute 1e-5 endpoint tolerance failed on high cross-entropy despite identical checkpoint logits.
findings.resolution: Explicit evaluator-v1.1 handoff uses atol=rtol=1e-6; original analyzer and failed request persist. Endpoints are recomputed in float64, and all final checkpoint/NPZ logits must still match bitwise.

findings.finding: Four independent paired seeds provide weak population uncertainty; t intervals assume a suitable sampling distribution and sign-flip p-values are coarse.
findings.resolution: Report each paired difference, SD, SE, 95% df=3 t interval and all-16 sign-flip calculation; make no broad population/significance claim. More independent seeds would be needed.

findings.finding: A 100000-update horizon cannot establish whether censored runs ever generalize; only two decay levels and one MLP/optimizer/split fraction were tested.
findings.resolution: Use explicit censoring/null event times, separate memorization/improvement/grokking claims, and restrict every conclusion to this configuration.

findings.finding: The installed checklist supplies schema/direct-digest assurance, and this substantive critique is by the same agent.
findings.resolution: Label scientific critique provisional; do not claim independent scientific peer review. Independent review remains a future requirement for stronger assurance.

findings.finding: Code paths and training records alone do not verify saved predictions or reported numbers.
findings.resolution: Reload every final checkpoint and NPZ weight set, recompute every endpoint, verify raw digests, and repeat the numerical analysis in a second directory. A second complete fresh-environment training execution was not run.

findings.finding: 100-update evaluations and a first-of-three rule discretize event times; a three-point window is not proof of permanent generalization.
findings.resolution: Report both initial and confirming evaluation times plus one-factor definition sensitivity. No change to the frozen primary analysis.

findings.finding: Held-out ordered pairs share the same modular operation and may include swapped versions of training pairs; examples are not independent tasks.
findings.resolution: Use seed as the independent unit and avoid extrapolating to new operations or architectures. The supplied split is followed exactly.
